name: comp-138
blurb: Checkbox for agreeing to terms of service with embedded link.
description: Terms agreement checkbox with label containing a hyperlinked 'terms of service' phrase. Demonstrates combining checkboxes with inline links.
use_when: Sign-up or registration forms requiring terms acceptance.
avoid_when: This link opens externally—ensure the destination is relevant before using.
a11y: Checkbox and label properly associated. Link is underlined and has target='_blank' warning. Full keyboard navigation.
